source: Internal session_store_sql, local assistant_usage_events and turns

units.aiu: Recorded total_nano_aiu divided by 1000000000. Not dollars.
units.input_tokens: Sum of request prompt sizes. Includes cache reads and writes.
units.noncached_input_tokens: input_tokens minus cache_read_tokens; not necessarily unique text.
units.output_tokens: Recorded output tokens. Do not add reasoning_tokens again.

long_running_inspector.caveat: A multi-day correction and verification conversation, not a single representative inspection. The premium counterfactual is not a guaranteed saving from rotation.

illustrative_prefix_reduction.assumptions: One initial cache write followed by 26 cache reads, at observed base rates. Output and trajectory unchanged.

orchestration_example.caveat: These turns include useful integration, fixes and checks. Their entire cost is not avoidable notification overhead. Ten root calls did not join a retained turns row.

isolated_blueprint_author_example.caveat: A multi-repository planning update with external research reports, not a generic small-task planning baseline.

blueprint_corpus.source: blueprint_combined.json, collected by the source research agent
blueprint_corpus.token_estimate_caveat: Document token sizes are heuristics, not tokenizer measurements. Session usage tokens above are measured.

date_only_mtime_cohort.filter: Recorded local mtime >= 2026-10-08, not an exact rolling-seven-day cutoff

limitations: Purposive identifiable phase sample, not a random sample or all Minime work.
Standalone inspector session totals exclude parent orchestration and separately launched reviewers.
Some older sessions retain usage and metadata but not detailed turns.
Cloud session_usage.cost is an aggregate of model request multipliers, not the token-priced AIU field used here.
No controlled comparison against the same task without Minime.
